tools.name: price_per_litre
tools.description: Convert a Brazilian beer price into reais per litre, the unit Cerveja Barata ranks by. Give the price paid in BRL, the volume of one unit in ml and how many units the price buys (e.g. 5 for a bucket of 5 long necks).

tools.description: Beer prices in a city, cheapest per litre first. tools.name: cheapest_now

tools.name: list_neighbourhoods
tools.description: The city's bairros (neighbourhoods) with beer prices: how many bars, shops and prices each has, and its cheapest price per litre at a bar and at a shop, kept apart, most bars first. Pass a slug as the neighbourhood argument of search_deals.

tools.name: price_index
tools.description: The monthly Índice Cerveja Barata for a city: median, quartiles and minimum price per litre at bars, for the whole city and by format, bairro and brand, with how many prices and bars each cell rests on. Latest month by default; final once the month is closed.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: The cities covered (with how many prices each has), the beer brands and the serving formats: the slugs the other tools take.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_venue" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Details of one bar, supermarket or depósito (kind, drink_on_site, bairro, address, location, Instagram, opening hours, attributes) and every beer price it has, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
